conventions.commits: Conventional commits with feat/chore/test/fix prefixes; DCO signed (Signed-off-by); scout/guard/plan/check handoff pattern for multi-agent workflows
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language module files (test_extract_function_name, test_find_receiver_type, test_element_query_happy_path, test_extract_inheritance); integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs; defuse_query tests via SemanticExtractor::extract_def_use_for_file
conventions.linting: Workspace lints: clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks=deny, clippy::unwrap_used=deny, clippy::expect_used=deny (with test exemptions); cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy -- -D warnings; cargo deny check advisories licenses
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; Option<T> for nullable returns; Result<T, AnalyzeError> for fallible operations; bounds checks on node.end_byte() vs source.len() before slicing

patterns: Every language module exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as &'static str constants
ELEMENT_QUERY uses named captures @func_name/@class_name/@interface_name/@enum_name and @function/@class tags
extract_inheritance() takes &Node and &str, returns Vec<String> with 'extends X' and 'implements Y' format
Handler functions (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver) take (&Node, &str, Option<usize>) and return Option<String>
Tree-sitter language binding imported as tree_sitter_<lang>::LANGUAGE.into() in mod.rs match arms
Language registered in EXTENSION_MAP (lang.rs), mod.rs pub mod, and get_language_info() match arm
Tests use Parser::new(), set_language(), parse(), Query::new(), QueryCursor::new(), matches() iteration
DEFUSE_QUERY captures local_variable_declaration, assignment_expression, update_expression, and generic (identifier) @read.usage

constraints: tree-sitter 0.27.1 API: Language objects obtained via tree_sitter_<lang>::LANGUAGE.into()
Workspace dependencies must be >=7 days old (enforced in CI); tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 is available and meets age requirement
No feature gates: all languages compiled unconditionally (lang-* features removed)
Path validation in src/validation.rs; shell detection in src/shell.rs; exec output filtering in src/filters.rs
Workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (test exemptions via cfg_attr)
MCP tool surface: parameter schemas via schemars; no legacy fields; strict contract
test_coverage: Integration tests cover file-level analysis (analyze_file) and directory-level analysis (analyze_directory) for each language. Unit tests in language modules verify: (1) query compilation, (2) element extraction (functions/classes/interfaces/enums), (3) inheritance extraction, (4) defuse sites (write/read/writeread). Test patterns: parse source, run query, iterate matches, verify captured names and node text. Defuse tests use SemanticExtractor::extract_def_use_for_file(src, lang, symbol, path, None) and check DefUseKind enum variants.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; node kinds: function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration, trait_declaration; fields: name (required), body (required, declaration_list), base_clause (extends), class_interface_clause (implements)
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause as child nodes (not fields) for inheritance. Functions are function_definition; methods are method_declaration. Enums, interfaces, and traits are first-class declarations. Anonymous classes supported via anonymous_class node.

library_findings.relevant_api: Parser::new(), Parser::set_language(), Parser::parse(), Query::new(), QueryCursor::new(), QueryCursor::matches(), Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::named_child(), Node::kind(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte(), Node::parent(), Node::child_count()
library_findings.notes: Core tree-sitter API used by all language handlers. Queries use S-expression syntax with named captures. Nodes have field-based access (child_by_field_name) and positional access (named_child). Byte ranges must be bounds-checked against source length.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Minimal PHP Integration (CSS-style)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY only; no inheritance extraction, no defuse_query, no handler functions. Register in mod.rs and lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 to Cargo.toml. Minimal test coverage.
pros: Lowest risk of query syntax errors

approaches.name: Approach 2: Full PHP Integration with Inheritance (Recommended)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extract_inheritance() handler. Register in mod.rs, lang.rs, and Cargo.toml. Comprehensive test coverage including inheritance, defuse sites, and all node kinds (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, enums, traits).
pros: Handles PHP-specific features: traits, enums, anonymous classes
cons: Requires understanding of PHP grammar (base_clause, class_interface_clause as child nodes, not fields)
DEFUSE_QUERY must capture PHP-specific patterns (variable_declaration, assignment_expression, etc.)
More complex query strings (5+ patterns per query)

approaches.name: Approach 3: Full Integration with Handler Functions
approaches.description: Extends Approach 2 with extract_function_name(), find_receiver_type(), find_method_for_receiver() handlers. Enables method-to-receiver mapping and receiver-to-method lookup. Requires understanding PHP's method resolution and class context navigation.
cons: Highest complexity: requires traversing parent nodes to find enclosing class/interface/trait
PHP allows nested classes and anonymous classes; traversal logic must handle these
More test cases needed (6+ additional tests)

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP Integration with Inheritance). This balances completeness with implementation risk. It provides feature parity with existing languages (Java, Kotlin, Swift) while avoiding the complexity of handler functions (Approach 3). It exceeds the minimal pattern (Approach 1) by supporting inheritance analysis and def-use sites, which are core to the tool's value proposition. The DEFUSE_QUERY is required because the issue says 'model after Java', and Java includes DEFUSE_QUERY; omitting it would be incomplete.

pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,

element_query_draft:
pub const ELEMENT_QUERY: &str = r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @func_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
";
defuse_query_draft:
pub const DEFUSE_QUERY: &str = r"
(variable_declaration declarator: (variable_declarator name: (variable_name (name)) @write.local))
(assignment_expression left: (variable_name (name)) @write.assign)
(assignment_expression left: (subscript_expression) @write.subscript)
(augmented_assignment_expression left: (variable_name (name)) @writeread.augmented)
(variable_name (name)) @read.usage
(name) @read.usage
";
inheritance_walk_citation: For a class_declaration node in tree-sitter-php: (1) call node.child_by_field_name("name") to get the class name (type name); (2) iterate node.child(i) for i in 0..node.child_count() to find child nodes of kind "base_clause" (represents 'extends'); (3) for each base_clause, iterate its named_child(j) to extract name nodes (each is a parent class name); (4) similarly find child nodes of kind "class_interface_clause" (represents 'implements'); (5) for each class_interface_clause, iterate its named_child(j) to extract name nodes (each is an interface name). Source: tree-sitter-php common/define-grammar.js class_declaration rule and php/src/node-types.json class_declaration entry.
